description: This source file manages file locking mechanisms in a version control context, including resolving symlinks, retry logic with exponential backoff for acquiring locks, and handling lock files. It appears to be part of a Git-related implementation for safe concurrent access.

methods.name: void trim_last_path_component(struct strbuf * path)
methods.description: Removes the last component from a file path, effectively moving up one directory level.

methods.name: void resolve_symlink(struct strbuf * path)
methods.description: Attempts to resolve symbolic links in a path, following them up to a maximum depth.

methods.name: int lock_file(struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags,int mode)
methods.description: Creates a lock file for a specified path, resolving symlinks if needed.

methods.name: int lock_file_timeout(struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags,long timeout_ms,int mode)
methods.description: Attempts to lock a file with retries and exponential backoff within a specified timeout.

methods.name: void unable_to_lock_message(const char * path,int err,struct strbuf * buf)
methods.description: Generates an error message indicating failure to acquire a lock.

methods.name: NORETURN void unable_to_lock_die(const char * path,int err)
methods.description: Outputs an error message and terminates execution if locking fails.

methods.name: int hold_lock_file_for_update_timeout_mode(struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags,long timeout_ms,int mode)
methods.description: High-level function to acquire a lock with timeout and mode, handling errors appropriately.

methods.name: char * get_locked_file_path(struct lock_file * lk)
methods.description: Retrieves the lock file's original path from the lock object.

methods.name: int commit_lock_file(struct lock_file * lk)
methods.description: Commits the lock by renaming or finalizing the lock file.
